PIPE-CONNSPEC-R175.requirement: **Every repository ships one-command agent setup.** Each repository tracks an idempotent, non-interactive `scripts/bootstrap.sh` that installs a current uv, the pinned Python (`.python-version`, else the fleet standard), the locked environment (`uv sync --locked`, or the repository's equivalent), and the pre-commit and pre-push hooks, then prints the gate command `uvx pre-commit run --all-files`. The script never pipes a network response into a shell: uv comes from `pip install --user` (retrying with `--break-system-packages`) or the script stops with the install link, so the `supply-chain` rule SC-INSTALL-001 stays clean.
PIPE-CONNSPEC-R175.verification: `pipelines-hook agent-contract` reports `scripts/bootstrap.sh is not tracked` for a repository without it, reports SC-INSTALL-001 for a script containing `curl ... \| sh`, and passes under `--strict` for a conformant fixture.

PIPE-CONNSPEC-R176.requirement: **Every repository carries the standard tool-neutral AGENTS.md section.** `AGENTS.md` holds the marked block `<!-- agent-contract:start -->` to `<!-- agent-contract:end -->` with the labels Owner boundary, Setup, Gates and Commits, and a link to the organization `AGENTS.md` at `https://github.com/Knuckles-Team/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md`. The block is tool-neutral; a tool-specific entry file such as `CLAUDE.md` only imports `AGENTS.md`. The connector scaffold in `universal-skills` generates both the script and the block.
PIPE-CONNSPEC-R176.verification: `pipelines-hook agent-contract --strict` fails for an `AGENTS.md` without the block, a missing label or a missing org link, and passes for a conformant fixture.

PIPE-CONNSPEC-R177.requirement: **The agent-contract check is warn-level first.** The hook `agent-contract` (pre-push) reports findings and exits 0; `--strict` makes them blocking once the fleet has converged. It reads the tracked set only.
PIPE-CONNSPEC-R177.verification: The default run exits 0 with a `WARN` line for a nonconforming fixture, and `--strict` exits 1.

  rev: 2834ec6639549dd6796205c8f011dedcd587288b  # frozen: v2.4.0

    args: ["--ignore-missing-imports"]

  rev: 258fe6a1974e89a2add9a45519a9e9dd9f46154e  # frozen: v2.16

    args: ["--skip", "B101,B404,B603"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/|__tests__/)
- repo: https://github.com/nbQA-dev/nbQA
  rev: f96ec7f3b26a32619435686eb5813235f7e3327e  # frozen: 1.9.1
  hooks:
  - id: nbqa-ruff
    args: ["--fix"]

    name: Dependency readiness — every declared intra-fleet constraint is installable
    entry: bash -c 'P=""; d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do [ -d "$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager" ] && { P="$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager"; break; }; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$P" ] || P=repository-manager; uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --prerelease=allow --with "$P" python -m repository_manager.dependency_readiness .'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
    stages: [manual, pre-push]
  - id: uv-lock
    name: uv-lock (verify, never mutate)
    entry: uv lock --check
    language: system
    files: ^(uv\.lock|pyproject\.toml|uv\.toml)$
    pass_filenames: false
    stages: [pre-push, manual]
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: mermaid-validate

    language: node
    additional_dependencies: ['@zabaca/mermaid-validate@1.0.1']

    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
  - id: env-var-drift
    name: check env-var/config drift
    entry: bash -c 'if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv run python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; else python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; fi'

  - id: check-cli-help

.pre-commit-config.yaml.content:
# Without this, `pre-commit install` wires ONLY the pre-commit hook, so `git push`
# runs nothing and every hook staged pre-push is silently dead code.
default_install_hook_types: [pre-commit, pre-push]
default_language_version:
  python: python3
# Phase 0 dev-velocity contract (arbora-completion-program): a hook with no
# explicit `stages:` below is commit-only, never both.
default_stages: [pre-commit]
exclude: 'dotnet|node_modules'
ci:
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_commit_msg: '[pre-commit.ci] pre-commit suggestions'
  autoupdate_schedule: 'monthly'

repos:
- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
  rev: 3e8a8703264a2f4a69428a0aa4dcb512790b2c8c # v6.0.0
  hooks:
  - id: check-added-large-files
    args: ["--maxkb=2000"]
  - id: check-ast
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/)
  - id: check-yaml
    args: ["--unsafe"]
  - id: check-toml
  - id: check-json
  - id: fix-byte-order-marker
    exclude: .gitignore
  - id: check-merge-conflict
  - id: detect-private-key
  - id: trailing-whitespace
  - id: end-of-file-fixer
  - id: no-commit-to-branch
- repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
  rev: 38bfb07c0c64c304f47eb52090f8288150c77730  # frozen: v0.17.1
  hooks:
  - id: ruff-check
    args: ["--fix", "--ignore=E402,B008,E501"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/)
  - id: ruff-format
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/)
- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
  rev: 2834ec6639549dd6796205c8f011dedcd587288b  # frozen: v2.4.0
  hooks:
  - id: mypy
    additional_dependencies: [pydantic==2.13.4, types-PyYAML==6.0.12.20260518, types-requests==2.33.0.20260518,
        types-setuptools==83.0.0.20260706]
    args: ["--ignore-missing-imports"]
- repo: https://github.com/jendrikseipp/vulture
  rev: 258fe6a1974e89a2add9a45519a9e9dd9f46154e  # frozen: v2.16
  hooks:
  - id: vulture
    pass_filenames: false
    args: [".", "--min-confidence", "95", "--exclude", "node_modules,dotnet,.venv,venv,node_modules,.git,build,dist",
      "--ignore-names", "request"]
    require_serial: true
- repo: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
  rev: 57b21406f092110c18776e39b0bda50d37c945c8  # frozen: v2.4.3
  hooks:
  - id: codespell
    args: ["-L", "ans,linar,nam,tread,ot,", "--ignore-words=.codespellignore"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/|.*lock.*)
- repo: https://github.com/PyCQA/bandit
  rev: 92ae8b82fb422a639f0ed8d99e96cea769594e08 # 1.9.4
  hooks:
  - id: bandit
    args: ["--skip", "B101,B404,B603"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/|__tests__/)
- repo: https://github.com/nbQA-dev/nbQA
  rev: f96ec7f3b26a32619435686eb5813235f7e3327e  # frozen: 1.9.1
  hooks:
  - id: nbqa-ruff
    args: ["--fix"]
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: dependency-readiness
    name: Dependency readiness — every declared intra-fleet constraint is installable
    entry: bash -c 'P=""; d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do [ -d "$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager" ] && { P="$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager"; break; }; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$P" ] || P=repository-manager; uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --prerelease=allow --with "$P" python -m repository_manager.dependency_readiness .'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
    stages: [manual, pre-push]
  - id: uv-lock
    name: uv-lock (verify, never mutate)
    entry: uv lock --check
    language: system
    files: ^(uv\.lock|pyproject\.toml|uv\.toml)$
    pass_filenames: false
    stages: [pre-push, manual]
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: mermaid-validate
    name: mermaid-validate
    entry: mermaid-validate
    language: node
    additional_dependencies: ['@zabaca/mermaid-validate@1.0.1']
    types: [markdown]
    pass_filenames: true
  - id: check-agent-standards
    name: check agent standards
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'for f in $(find . -type f -name "agent_server.py" -not -path "*/\.venv/*" -not -path "*/__pycache__/*"); do grep -q "warnings.filterwarnings" "$f" && grep -q "file=sys.stderr" "$f" || { echo "Missing warnings.filterwarnings or file=sys.stderr in $f"; exit 1; }; done'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
  - id: env-var-drift
    name: check env-var/config drift
    entry: bash -c 'if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv run python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; else python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; fi'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    files: ^(README\.md|\.env\.example|mcp_config.*\.json|.*/mcp_config.*\.json|docker/.*compose.*\.ya?ml|.*/auth\.py|.*/mcp_server\.py)$
  - id: check-cli-help
    name: check cli help
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'for f in $(find . -type f \( -name "mcp_server.py" -o -name "agent_server.py" \) -not -path "*/\.venv/*" -not -path "*/__pycache__/*"); do mod=$(echo "$f" | sed -e "s/^\.\///" -e "s/\.py$//" -e "s/\//./g"); uv run --frozen --all-extras python -m "$mod" --help >/dev/null || exit 1; done'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
  - id: check-bumpversion
    name: validate bumpversion config
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'if [ -f ".bumpversion.cfg" ]; then bump2version patch --dry-run --allow-dirty; fi'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: pytest
    name: pytest
    entry: bash -c 'test_target="tests"; for d in tests/unit test/unit tests test; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then test_target="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv run --all-extras pytest "$test_target" -q --tb=short -m "not slow" --timeout=60; else pytest "$test_target" -q --tb=short -m "not slow" --timeout=60; fi'
    language: system
    types: [python]
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
    stages: [pre-push, manual]
- repo: https://github.com/AleksaC/hadolint-py
  rev: 6e7504451511eaeb62a3e7f14d63b0296cbf86eb  # frozen: v2.15.1
  hooks:
  - id: hadolint
    args:
    - --ignore=DL3008
    - --ignore=DL3015
    - --ignore=DL3009
    - --ignore=DL4006
    - --ignore=SC2102
- repo: https://github.com/IamTheFij/docker-pre-commit
  rev: f626253b23de45412865c07fd076ff95d4cd77a7 # v3.0.1
  hooks:
  - id: docker-compose-check
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: security-sanitizer
    name: Security and Garbage Sanitizer
    entry: python scripts/security_sanitizer.py
    language: python
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true

name: Deploy GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'mkdocs.yml'
      - 'README.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

    permissions:
      contents: read

      id-token: write

# Without this, `pre-commit install` wires ONLY the pre-commit hook, so `git push`
# runs nothing and every hook staged pre-push is silently dead code.
default_install_hook_types: [pre-commit, pre-push]
default_language_version:
  python: python3
# Phase 0 dev-velocity contract (arbora-completion-program): a hook with no
# explicit `stages:` below is commit-only, never both.
default_stages: [pre-commit]
exclude: 'dotnet|node_modules'
ci:
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_commit_msg: '[pre-commit.ci] pre-commit suggestions'
  autoupdate_schedule: 'monthly'

repos:
- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
  rev: 3e8a8703264a2f4a69428a0aa4dcb512790b2c8c # v6.0.0
  hooks:
  - id: check-added-large-files
    args: ["--maxkb=2000"]
  - id: check-ast
  - id: check-yaml
    args: ["--unsafe"]
  - id: check-toml
  - id: check-json
  - id: fix-byte-order-marker
    exclude: .gitignore
  - id: check-merge-conflict
  - id: detect-private-key
  - id: trailing-whitespace
  - id: end-of-file-fixer
  - id: no-commit-to-branch
- repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
  rev: 38bfb07c0c64c304f47eb52090f8288150c77730 # v0.17.1
  hooks:
  - id: ruff
    types_or: [python, pyi, jupyter]
    args: ["--fix", "--ignore=E402"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/)
- repo: https://github.com/jendrikseipp/vulture
  rev: b0f67ba0044693aa9ec0d38fe460590facc98004 # v2.16
  hooks:
  - id: vulture
    pass_filenames: false
    args: [".", "--min-confidence", "95", --exclude, '.venv,venv,node_modules,.git,build,dist']     # or 100 if you want very high confidence only
    require_serial: true
- repo: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
  rev: 57b21406f092110c18776e39b0bda50d37c945c8 # v2.4.3
  hooks:
  - id: codespell
    args: ["-L", "ans,linar,nam,tread,ot,"]
- repo: https://github.com/PyCQA/bandit
  rev: 2d0b675b04c80ae42277e10500db06a0a37bae17 # 1.8.6
  hooks:
  - id: bandit
    args: ["--skip", "B101,B404,B603"]
    exclude: ^(tests/|test/|scripts/|script/|__tests__/)
- repo: https://github.com/nbQA-dev/nbQA
  rev: d31b7eae1767c43460afb3ba130e0a6602933abe # 1.9.1
  hooks:
  - id: nbqa-ruff
    exclude: ^(\.\/test/|\./tests/)
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: dependency-readiness
    name: Dependency readiness — every declared intra-fleet constraint is installable
    entry: bash -c 'P=""; d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do [ -d "$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager" ] && { P="$d/agent-packages/agents/repository-manager"; break; }; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$P" ] || P=repository-manager; uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --prerelease=allow --with "$P" python -m repository_manager.dependency_readiness .'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
    stages: [manual, pre-push]
  - id: mermaid-validate
    name: mermaid-validate
    entry: mermaid-validate
    language: node
    additional_dependencies: ['@zabaca/mermaid-validate@1.0.1']
    types: [markdown]
    pass_filenames: true
  - id: check-agent-standards
    name: check agent standards
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'for f in $(find . -type f -name "mcp_server.py" -not -path "*/\.venv/*" -not -path "*/__pycache__/*"); do grep -q "warnings.filterwarnings\|import warnings" "$f" || { echo "Missing warnings.filterwarnings in $f"; exit 1; }; done'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
  - id: env-var-drift
    name: check env-var/config drift
    entry: bash -c 'if [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv run python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; else python -m agent_connector_sdk.mcp.env_drift --check; fi'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    files: ^(README\.md|\.env\.example|mcp_config.*\.json|.*/mcp_config.*\.json|docker/.*compose.*\.ya?ml|.*/auth\.py|.*/mcp_server\.py)$
  - id: check-cli-help
    name: check cli help
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'for f in $(find . -type f \( -name "mcp_server.py" -o -name "mcp_server.py" \) -not -path "*/\.venv/*" -not -path "*/__pycache__/*"); do mod=$(echo "$f" | sed -e "s/^\.\///" -e "s/\.py$//" -e "s/\//./g"); uv run python -m "$mod" --help >/dev/null || exit 1; done'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
  - id: check-bumpversion
    name: validate bumpversion config
    entry: |-
      bash -c 'if [ -f ".bumpversion.cfg" ]; then bump2version patch --dry-run --allow-dirty; fi'
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
- repo: https://github.com/AleksaC/hadolint-py
  rev: 6e7504451511eaeb62a3e7f14d63b0296cbf86eb # v2.15.1
  hooks:
  - id: hadolint
    args:
    - --ignore=DL3008
    - --ignore=DL3015
    - --ignore=DL3009
    - --ignore=DL4006
    - --ignore=SC2102
- repo: https://github.com/IamTheFij/docker-pre-commit
  rev: f626253b23de45412865c07fd076ff95d4cd77a7 # v3.0.1
  hooks:
  - id: docker-compose-check
- repo: local
  hooks:
  - id: security-sanitizer
    name: Security and Garbage Sanitizer
    entry: python scripts/security_sanitizer.py
    language: python
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
